notes: Portable IEEE 1516.1-2025 public-API translation of the verified native three-member directive-1 resignation case. The adapter supplies the provider, endpoint, FOM, ordinary object class and attribute, logical-time implementation, and HLA_EVOKED callback configuration. Two subscribed and publishing survivors discover one object registered by the departing owner. After UNCONDITIONALLY_DIVEST_ATTRIBUTES, neither survivor has received a callback until serviced. Servicing only the first delivers exactly one Request Attribute Ownership Assumption with the object, its resolved ordinary attribute, standard HLAprivilegeToDeleteObject, and empty resignation tag; the second queue remains untouched. Servicing the second delivers the same standard offer independently without repeating the first. Direct mappings are requirement-candidate-content-clauses-04-federation-management-page-058-l125-35 and page-058-l147-40 to canonical clause 4.12. This does not claim complete resignation-action coverage, ownership arbitration, immediate callback ordering, or conformance. Official-header C++ primary/contract passed 2/2 HLA_EVOKED twice against current-source installed package libraries; both-mode reports two passes and two explicit immediate skips. Java parity compiles against the official API-only JAR but has no provider-runtime result.
